name: Fadefield
description: The same mark throughout, coming up in strength from one corner to the other.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 10%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: 50%; opacity: @calc(0.15 + 0.85 * (@x + @y) / (@X + @Y)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
